column1: # Per-row adjudication of the unlisted code blocks, for the UC-1 population change.
# Voted 3-0 (FABLE, OPUS, ASTRA) 2026-09-13: admit distinct bodies as unexplained frontier,
# never as a D exception. `body` rows are admitted; `continuation` rows extend an existing
# extent; `ambiguous` rows are a declared uncertainty band and are never silently dropped.
# `table` rows (added 2026-09-25, OPUS) open with >= 3 image-base RVAs into the predecessor: its
# inline jump table - data, not admitted. Control: 0 of the listed bodies meet the test.
# `decodes_to_end` is the body-shape gate: a linear decode from the first byte reaching the
# last. Listed bodies pass 100.0/99.8/98.7/97.8/92.6 % by size band; the admitted rows pass
# 99.6/87.8/45.0/42.9/44.4 % (computed on this run; tables are not admitted). A `no` does not mean the bytes are data - it means the
# BOUNDARY is not established, which is why no denominator has moved.
# `referenced` counts only the two pass-6-admissible routes - rel32 call/jmp + RIP lea, and
# base-relocation DIR64. `routes` names every route that lists the block; `pdata` (the PE
# exception directory) is unwind metadata, banned as evidence under FINAL-AUDIT-PROTOCOL
# pass 6, so a `pdata` route never makes `referenced` yes. Split per OPUS-REQ-SWE2-EC7-
# UNLISTED-REFERENCED-ROUTES, 2026-09-17 - the earlier union made exactly one body row
# look referenced on unwind data alone.
